svg.title: Amberly Care Workshop small business tech support portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional it support portfolio concept for Amberly Care Workshop, showing a calm small-business workstation and network setup. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
